title: Royal Indian Wedding Portrait
promptText: Transform the provided reference photo into a luxurious royal Indian wedding portrait while preserving the exact identity and recognizable facial characteristics of the person in the reference image. Maintain the original facial structure, face shape, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, jawline, cheekbones, hairstyle, beard or facial hair, natural skin tone, age-defining characteristics, and distinctive personal features. The person must remain clearly recognizable as the same individual. Do not replace, redesign, beautify, masculinize, feminize, age, de-age, or otherwise alter the person's identity. Create an elegant grand Indian wedding setting inspired by a luxurious palace venue with carved architectural details, warm golden chandeliers, floral arrangements, rich fabrics, and softly glowing ceremonial lights. Dress the subject in sophisticated traditional Indian wedding attire with intricate embroidery, premium fabrics, elegant jewelry or accessories appropriate to the subject, and refined styling. Create a confident yet naturally emotional pose with realistic hands, anatomy, posture, and facial expression. Use warm golden cinematic lighting with subtle highlights across the face, clothing, jewelry, and surrounding architecture. Preserve natural skin texture, pores, fine facial details, realistic hair strands, authentic eyes and natural imperfections. Capture the image like a premium full-frame professional wedding photograph using an 85mm lens with shallow depth of field, beautiful background bokeh, realistic lens compression, soft highlight rolloff, and cinematic separation. Include subtle floral foreground elements and softly blurred wedding lights to create depth. Apply sophisticated luxury color grading with warm gold, ivory, deep maroon, and subtle neutral tones while keeping skin tones natural. Ultra-photorealistic Indian wedding photography, luxury editorial aesthetic, realistic fabric texture, detailed embroidery, authentic jewelry reflections, cinematic atmosphere, natural skin, realistic hands, realistic anatomy, 8K detail, no identity change, no facial distortion, no plastic skin, no cartoon appearance, 3:4 composition.
